name: Antcopter
author: Eduardo Bart
description: Guide a tiny flying ant through maze-like cave levels lined with spikes, picking up items along the way. Made for the first WASM-4 game jam.

descriptions.en: Guide a tiny flying ant through maze-like cave levels lined with spikes, picking up items along the way. Made for the first WASM-4 game jam.
descriptions.it: Guida una piccola formica volante attraverso livelli a labirinto pieni di spuntoni, raccogliendo oggetti lungo la strada. Creato per la prima game jam di WASM-4.
